texts.C: Call C: José Sánchez, living in a residential street in Massanassa. The family has already been evacuated safely and nobody is inside; they ask for a crew to stop the water coming into the house. Water 0.9 m deep and rising; waiting for help for 10 minutes so far.
texts.D: Call D: Francisco Pérez, a permanent resident of the area, living in a residential street in Massanassa. 8 people trapped in the home; water 2 m deep and rising; waiting for help for 90 minutes so far.
texts.E: Call E: María José López, a permanent resident of the area, living in a residential street in Massanassa. 7 people trapped in the home; water 1.8 m deep and rising; waiting for help for 90 minutes so far.
